description: This file defines a PHP class 'TableOfContentsRenderer' which implements the 'NodeRendererInterface' to render a table of contents macro for Confluence pages, using the League\CommonMark library for markdown processing.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class that generates a Confluence structured macro for a table of contents using the provided markdown node.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method that creates an HTML element representing the Confluence macro 'toc' using the given Node and child renderer.
